name: Goshi
description: Voice AI companion for Reachy Mini - Say "Sushi" to chat!

paragraphs: Goshi is a high-performance, low-latency streaming voice AI companion for the Reachy Mini robot. It transforms Reachy Mini into an interactive assistant that can hold natural conversations, react to wake words, and express itself through gestures.
features: 🎙️ Always-On Interaction - Natural, continuous flow without needing to repeat a wake word.
⚡ Low Latency - Real-time streaming with <800ms response time for a natural flow.
🌍 Bilingual Support - Seamlessly switch between French and English with automatic detection.
🤖 Expressive Gestures - Dynamic head and antenna movements synchronized with speech.
📡 LiveKit/WebRTC - Robust, high-quality audio streaming powered by LiveKit.

whatItDoes.text: Goshi is a high-performance, low-latency streaming voice AI companion for the Reachy Mini robot. It transforms Reachy Mini into an interactive assistant that can hold natural conversations, react to wake words, and express itself through gestures.

requirements.text: 🔧 Local First - All heavy processing happens on your local workstation (no cloud subscription required).
